name: DashHQ Radar
author: PastaPastaPasta
description: Read-only explorer for the whole Dash network: Core blocks, transactions, mempool and governance, masternodes and the node census, and Dash Platform identities, contracts, tokens and names. Platform reads are proof-checked where Platform offers a proof, and every figure shows its source. Covers mainnet, testnet and devnets, with a public JSON API.
